name: GitRepositoryResource
description:
GitRepositoryResource clones a git repository into the workspace.

 Only HTTPS clone URLs are supported.

 A private repository is cloned with the resource's own token when it
 carries one, else with a login saved for the repository's host
 (github.com) in the vaults the conversation uses. The resource's own
 token is used only for an https://github.com repository: a session write
 carrying a token for any other repository is refused.

fields.name: Url
fields.description: HTTPS clone URL for the repository.

fields.name: Branch
fields.description: Branch to clone. Empty clones the repository's default branch.

fields.name: Commit
fields.description:
Commit to check out after the clone. With a branch, the branch is
 cloned first, then the commit is checked out.

fields.name: WriteBackMode
fields.description:
Whether the platform turns the agent's changes into a branch and a pull
 request.

fields.name: Token
fields.description:
A token for cloning this repository, kept for the conversation only.

 Used only when the URL is an https://github.com repository; a session
 write carrying a token for any other repository is refused. Sealed for
 the conversation's life and never returned by a read. A routine's
 repositories refuse it: save the token in a vault the routine names.
